## `Hooks` { #hooks-static-class }

`public static class Hooks`

Static factory for all Hooks, imported with `using static` by the SDK so pages declare their persistent state without `new`. Keep the result in a page field: a hook called inside Body() creates a fresh object on every rebuild.

**Méthodes**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `static LazyListState UseLazyList()` | Explicit state of a lazy list or pager, to observe or drive its scroll. |
| `static ScrollState UseScroll()` | Scroll position for `.Scrollable(...)`, kept across rebuilds. |
| `static State<T> UseState<T>(T initialValue)` | Creates a new reactive state variable. When bound to a UI component (e.g. Text), updating the Value will automatically remeasure and redraw the component without rebuilding the UI tree. |
| `static State<T>[] UseStates<T>(int count, T initialValue)` | `count` independent states sharing one initial value. |
| `static TextEditController UseTextEdit(string initialText = "", int historyLimit = 100)` | Controller of a `TextField` or `TextArea`, caret after `initialText`. |

## `State<T>` { #state-t-class }

`public class State<T>`

A reactive container for a value, inspired by React's useState and SolidJS's Signals. When the Value property is modified, it triggers OnChanged to notify bound UI components.

**Constructeurs**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `State<T>(T initialValue)` |  |

**Propriétés**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `T Value { get; set; }` | Gets or sets the reactive value. Setting a new value triggers OnChanged. |

**Méthodes**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `virtual string ToString()` |  |

**Événements**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `event Action OnChanged` | Event fired whenever the Value changes. UI components subscribe to this to trigger fine-grained updates without rebuilding the tree. |
